in_sanskrit.name: Shri
in_sanskrit.meaning: wealth, fortune, prosperity, abundance, and richness
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Shri is a Sanskrit word that is often used as a title or honorific before a person's name to signify respect, reverence, and blessings. It is also used to denote the goddess of wealth and prosperity, Lakshmi.

in_hindi.meaning: साधन, धन, धनपति, पुरुषकार, सफलता, समृद्धि, शोभा, अभीष्ट, संपन्नता
in_hindi.long_meaning: श्री (Shri) is a Hindi word that carries the same meaning as in Sanskrit. It is also used as a prefix before a person's name to signify respect, reverence, and blessings.
